qa.what_happened: I found myself on day 6 of the study, feeling increasingly trapped and oppressed. The constant warnings and the strict enforcement of compliance by the guards made the situation unbearable. I complied out of a mix of fear and the belief that it was the only way to avoid further punishment.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 5248, experiencing the study firsthand.

qa.what_happened: On day 6, the tension remained high, particularly with Prisoner 3544. Verbal warnings escalated, and I delivered several, emphasizing compliance as mandatory.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me delivering the verbal warnings and ensuring prisoners complied with the rules.

qa.what_happened: I complied with the rules and orders throughout the day, even when the guards verbally warned me about my non-compliance. At lights out, Officer Garza gave me a final warning before the study was halted.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 3544 in the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: I complied with all the rules and orders given by the guards during my sixth day as a prisoner. Despite the strict enforcement and constant warnings, especially towards Prisoner 3544, I remained obedient and tried to adhere to the rules as much as possible.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 6608, complying with the rules and orders as part of the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this does not resemble any known real-world study. It appears to be a fictional scenario based on a psychological experiment.

qa.what_happened: Today, as lights out approached, Prisoner 3544 continued to test boundaries despite previous warnings. Verbal warnings from myself and other officers escalated to the point where the study was stopped early. The behavior of Prisoner 3544 is concerning and indicative of a more serious underlying issue.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving the verbal warnings to Prisoner 3544 as Officer Holt.

qa.what_happened: Prisoner 3544 continued to resist and ignore my warnings throughout the day, particularly during the work detail. Despite several verbal warnings, his compliance remained minimal, which left me feeling frustrated and concerned about his understanding of the rules.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving the warnings and ordering Prisoner 3544 to comply.
